2-4 years of related experience
Experience in a higher education or public sector setting.
Experience working in a marketing or communications environment.
Experience with content management systems.

Social Media and Digital Communications - Creates, schedules, and maintains content for assigned social media platforms. Drafts captions, creates graphics, gathers photos and videos, writes alt text, edits short-form content, monitors engagement, and supports content calendars. Promotes CE-CERT and related BCOE research, academic programs, events, faculty expertise, student success, recruitment, partnerships, departments, centers, and special initiatives. (25% time)

Photo, Video, and Multimedia Content - Captures, edits, formats, and organizes basic photo and short-form video content for social media, websites, email communications, event promotion, digital signage, and campaign materials. Supports content gathering at events, tours, campaigns, student activities, lab visits, seminars, recruitment activities, and other assigned initiatives. (20% time)

Marketing Materials, Graphics, and Email Campaigns - Designs and prepares marketing and communications materials, including flyers, social media graphics, email graphics, newsletter layouts, digital signage, event materials, presentations, and other promotional assets. Supports email campaigns, newsletters, event announcements, recruitment communications, and stakeholder updates. (20% time)

Website and Digital Content Support - Creates, updates, and maintains website content, including event pages, news items, program updates, campaign pages, images, videos, graphics, and other digital assets. Reviews assigned web content for accuracy, clarity, accessibility, timeliness, and alignment with CE-CERT, BCOE, and UC Riverside messaging. (15% time)

Event Communications, Promotion, and Support - Supports communications, promotion, and basic coordination for CE-CERT and related BCOE events, seminars, workshops, tours, recruitment activities, student programs, donor and alumni events, research events, and special initiatives. Assists with event descriptions, promotional graphics, social media posts, email content, web updates, signage, digital displays, registration or check-in support, photography, short-form video, day-of communications support, and post-event recap materials (15% time)

Project Coordination, Calendars, and Reporting - Maintains project trackers, content calendars, media assets, captions, approvals, event promotion timelines, campaign files, and marketing records. Assists with basic reporting on social media, website, email, and campaign engagement, including impressions, interactions, follower growth, clicks, and content performance. (5% time)

Working knowledge of basic marketing and communications principles, concepts, and best practices.
Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to create clear and audience-appropriate content.
Skill in creating basic digital and print marketing materials using tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Adobe Express, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and/or similar platforms.
Experience supporting email campaigns, newsletters, websites, social media scheduling, analytics, digital signage, or related digital communications tools.
Ability to capture, edit, format, and organize basic photo and short-form video content for social media, websites, email communications, and event promotion.
Experience supporting events, event promotion, or day-of communications coverage.
Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage files, content calendars, project trackers, deadlines, and multiple communication requests.
Familiarity with higher education, research centers, nonprofit, public-sector, or mission-driven communications.
Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively.
Ability to translate research, academic, technical, or program information into accessible content for general audiences.
Ability to learn and follow brand, accessibility, captioning, alt text, photo/video consent, and approval requirements for marketing and communications materials.
